'''Aldin Miheres''' was a mercenary working for [[Arymilla Marne]].

== History ==
At one time, he was a mercenary who worked with [[Rhys a'Balaman]].

== Activities ==
He was leading an attack against [[Caemlyn]] when he is shot in the neck by [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and killed.{{ref/book|11|13}}
